MASTER SERVICES AGREEMENT

This Master Services Agreement (the “Agreement”) is entered into as of {{effectiveDate}} (the “Effective Date”) by and between {{partyA.name}}, {{partyA.entityType}} (“Client”), and {{partyB.name}}, {{partyB.entityType}} (“Supplier”). Client and Supplier are each a “Party” and together the “Parties.”

1. Structure

This Agreement sets the terms for services Supplier provides to Client. Each engagement is described in a statement of work signed by both Parties (each, an “SOW”). This Agreement governs every SOW. Where an SOW conflicts with this Agreement, this Agreement controls unless the SOW expressly overrides a named section.

2. Services

Supplier will perform the services described in each SOW in a professional and workmanlike manner, using personnel with the necessary skill and experience.

3. Fees and Payment

Fees are set in each SOW. Supplier invoices as the SOW provides. Client pays undisputed invoices within {{paymentDays}} days of receipt. Client must raise any dispute in writing before the due date, and pay the undisputed portion on time. Fees exclude taxes, which Client pays other than taxes on Supplier’s income.

4. Term and Termination

This Agreement runs for {{termYears}} years from the Effective Date and renews automatically for successive {{renewalMonths}}-month periods unless either Party gives {{noticeDays}} days’ written notice before the end of the then-current term. Either Party may terminate this Agreement or any SOW for material breach that remains uncured 30 days after written notice, or immediately on the other Party’s insolvency. Termination of this Agreement terminates every open SOW. Client pays for services properly performed through the termination date.

5. Confidentiality

Each Party will hold the other’s non-public information in confidence, use it only to perform this Agreement, disclose it only to those who need it and are bound by equivalent obligations, and protect it with at least reasonable care. These obligations survive for three years after termination, and indefinitely for trade secrets.

6. Intellectual Property

Client owns the deliverables specified in each SOW on payment in full. Supplier retains ownership of its pre-existing materials, tools and general know-how, and grants Client a perpetual, worldwide, non-exclusive, royalty-free licence to use them as incorporated into the deliverables. Neither Party acquires any other right in the other’s intellectual property.

7. Data Protection

Where Supplier processes personal data on Client’s behalf, it does so only on Client’s documented instructions, maintains appropriate technical and organisational security measures, and assists Client with data-subject requests and breach notification. The Parties will execute a data processing addendum where applicable law requires one.

8. Warranties

Each Party warrants it has authority to enter into this Agreement. Supplier warrants the services will conform to the relevant SOW and will not infringe any third-party intellectual property right. Except as stated, all other warranties are disclaimed to the extent permitted by law.

9. Indemnity

Supplier will defend Client against any third-party claim that the deliverables infringe an intellectual property right, and pay damages finally awarded, provided Client notifies Supplier promptly, gives Supplier control of the defence, and cooperates reasonably.

10. Limitation of Liability

Neither Party is liable for indirect, incidental, special, punitive or consequential damages, or for lost profits, however caused. Each Party’s aggregate liability under this Agreement is limited to {{liabilityCap}}. These limits do not apply to breach of confidentiality, the indemnity in Section 9, or a Party’s wilful misconduct.

11. Insurance

Supplier will maintain commercially reasonable insurance appropriate to the services, and provide evidence of coverage on request.

12. Non-Solicitation

During the term and for twelve months afterwards, neither Party will solicit for employment any employee of the other who was directly involved in the services. General advertising not targeted at those individuals is permitted.

13. Independent Contractors

The Parties are independent contractors. Neither is the agent of the other and neither may bind the other.

14. Assignment

Neither Party may assign this Agreement without the other’s written consent, except to a successor in a merger or sale of substantially all assets.

15. Notices

Notices must be in writing and sent to the addresses on the signature page, or to any address a Party later designates in writing.

Governing Law

This Agreement is governed by the laws of {{governingLaw}}, without regard to its conflict-of-laws rules.

Entire Agreement

This Agreement is the entire agreement between the Parties on its subject matter and supersedes all prior discussions. It may be amended only in a writing signed by both Parties. It may be executed in counterparts and by electronic signature, each of which is an original.

Execution

IN WITNESS WHEREOF, the parties have executed this Agreement as of the Effective Date.
